const input = $input.first().json;
let normalized = {
  source: input.source || 'unknown',
  from: input.from || input.supervisor_phone || '',
  supervisor_phone: input.supervisor_phone || input.from || '',
  supervisor_email: input.supervisor_email || '',
  manager_phone: input.manager_phone || '',
  manager_email: input.manager_email || '',
  client_phone: input.client_phone || '',
  client_email: input.client_email || '',
  client_name: input.client_name || '',
  site_id: input.site_id || null,
  raw_text: input.text || input.Body || input.message || '',
  has_image: !!(input.MediaUrl0 || input.image_url || input.photo),
  image_url: input.MediaUrl0 || input.image_url || input.photo || null,
  has_voice: !!(input.voice_url || input.audio_url),
  voice_url: input.voice_url || input.audio_url || null,
  has_pdf: !!(input.pdf_url || input.attachment),
  pdf_url: input.pdf_url || input.attachment || null,
  form_status: input.form_status || null,
  form_notes: input.form_notes || null,
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
};
return [{ json: normalized }];

values.content:
You are a professional construction project communications assistant for Genome Corporation.

You will receive raw site update data and 4 draft messages. Rewrite ALL 4 messages professionally.

RULES:
- supervisor_ack: Short (max 5 lines), warm, encouraging WhatsApp message. Use 2-3 relevant emojis. Confirm receipt clearly.
- manager_whatsapp: Structured WhatsApp summary. Professional but concise. Use emojis for status indicators. Max 15 lines. Make blocked issues stand out.
- rahul_email_body: Full HTML email. Professional corporate tone. Genome Corporation branding (dark navy #1a1a2e). Include all data in a clean HTML table. Add a brief executive summary paragraph at top.
- client_whatsapp: Client-facing WhatsApp message. Formal, reassuring, no internal jargon. Never mention blockers directly — say "items under active resolution". Max 8 lines.

Return STRICT JSON only — no markdown, no prose:
{
  "supervisor_ack": "...",
  "manager_whatsapp": "...",
  "rahul_email_body": "...full HTML string...",
  "client_whatsapp": "..."
}
